create_skeleton_h36m: create a Skeleton object with Human3.6M joint offsets, parents, and left/right joint indices
load_mocap_dataset: load a MocapDataset from an NPZ file with a given skeleton and frame rate
downsample_dataset: downsample the mocap dataset by an integer factor to reduce frame rate
compute_forward_kinematics: compute world-space joint positions from quaternion rotations and root trajectory using forward kinematics
mirror_dataset_sequences: augment the mocap dataset by mirroring all sequences and swapping left/right joints
